content.name: Metiv - The Israel Psychotrauma Center
content.legalName: The Metiv Association - The Israel Psychotrauma Center
content.headline: People need people
content.vision: A society that makes room for psychological trauma, cares for those who suffer from it and is committed to their empowerment.
content.mission: Our goal is to provide high-quality, humane and caring service to communities and individuals before, during and after trauma, and to share our comprehensive knowledge of psychological trauma through academic research and training so that others can embed this knowledge in their own communities.
content.intro: At Metiv, we understand that coping with trauma in times of war and terror is a complex journey. It is a journey that can affect every area of life, and so we are here to accompany you. We offer a safe and sensitive space where you can receive professional support and, together with us, create your path to coping and growing stronger. Because you are not alone.
content.address: Givat Shaul, Herzog Medical Center, Jerusalem
